install_steps: Teach agent the skill: sc skills teach a2a-skill:quickstart
Full docs: sc a2a-skill project init --project my-team
note: Requires Python 3.9+ with sqlite3 stdlib module. The a2a wrapper auto-finds a suitable python3 on PATH. All 14 CLI commands work with zero pip dependencies. Multi-language clients (Go, Node.js, Rust) are optional and require their respective runtimes.
